answer: Treat trust as bounded flow from honest seeds, capped by the narrowest cut. Standing is the maximum trust-flow an identity receives routed from the seed set across the graph, and by max-flow=min-cut that total is hard-limited by the thin ledge of edges linking a region to the honest core. A sybil clique on its own mesa sits behind a narrow bottleneck, so the WHOLE clique shares one small flow cap however many fakes it holds — adding members dilutes each slice rather than multiplying it. The cut acts like a prism splitting real capacity from manufactured bulk.
